senses.gloss:
इक्षु इक्षु (akin to इष्), m. Sugar cane, Man. 9, 39.
 --Comp.

इक्ष्वाकु इक्ष्वाकु, m.
 1. The name of the first king of Ayodhya, Rām. 1, 70, 20.
 2. A descendant of that king, Rām. 1, 70, 11.

ईक्ष् ईक्ष् (like अक्ष् in 1. अक्ष, a desider. of a lost vb., see अक्ष), i. 1, Ātm. (in epic poetry also Par., MBh. 15, 826).
 1. To look, Kathās. 25, 148. [] To behold, Śiś. 9, 61. To perceive, Bhag. 6, 29.
 2. To mind, Kumāras. 5, 82; ईक्षित, n. A look, Śāk. d. 44.
 --With the prep. अधि अधि, To suspect, Hit. iv. d. 101 (सत्ये प्य् अपायम् अधीक्षते, Suspects injury even in truth).
 --With अप अप,
 1. To see, Rām. 5, 42, 6.
 2. To mind, Pañc. v. d. 61. To pay regard to, Kathās. 17, 12.
 3. To intend, Vedāntas. in Chr. 215, 13.
 4. To require, Bhāṣāp. 63.
 5. To expect, Bhartṛ. 3, 66.
 अन्-अपेक्षित, adj.
 1. Not minded, Man. 8, 309; unregarded, Daśak. in Chr. 193, 3.
 2. Regardless, Prab. 34, 15.
 --With व्यप वि-अप,
 1. To look back, Rām. 2, 86, 22.
 2. To mind, Ragh. 19, 6.
 --With अव अव,
 1. To look at, MBh. 1, 5923; Rām. 3, 50, 11 (अवेक्ष्य-अवेक्ष्य, ever pursuing with his eyes).
 2. To perceive, Rām. 2, 45, 5.
 3. To consider, Man. 7, 10.
 4. To mind, MBh. 2, 2158; to regard, Rām. 6, 7, 48.
 दुस्-अवेक्षित, n. An unsuitable look, MBh. 3, 14669.
 सु-अव्च्क्षित, adj. Well pondered, Rām. 4, 31, 5.
 --With अन्वव अनु-अव,
 1. To look at, Rām. 1, 64, 9.
 2. To look round, Rām. 5, 16, 38.
 3. To perceive, Rām. 1, 3, 5.
 4. To reflect, Man. 6, 65.
 --With अभ्यव अभि-अव, To look at, MBh. 2, 2686.
 --With न्यव नि-अव, To ponder, MBh. 12, 4975.
 --With निरव निस्-अव, To perceive, Mṛcch. 86, 1.
 --With पर्यव परि-अव, To regard(?), MBh. 14, 636.
 --With प्रत्यव प्रति-अव,
 1. To look at, Rām. 2, 39, 1.
 2. To inspect one after the other, Śāk. 80, 21.
 3. To mind, Rām. 2, 32, 34.
 --With समव सम्-अव,
 1. To look at, Ṛt. 6, 17; to behold, MBh. 4, 218.
 2. To consider, Rām. 2, 78, 4.
 3. To reflect, Rām. 1, 50, 10.
 4. To pay regard to, Rām. 4, 19, 2. []
 --With उद् उद्,
 1. To look up to, Rām. 5, 30, 12.
 2. To look at, Man. 4, 77.
 3. To see, Rām. 2, 22, 7.
 4. To wait, Man. 9, 90; to expect, Rām. 6, 109, 5.
 --With अभ्युद् अभि-उद्, To look at, Rām. 6, 11, 2.
 --With प्रत्युद् प्रति-उद्, To look at, Rām. 2, 9, 19.
 --With समुद् सम्-उद्,
 1. To look, Rām. 3, 73, 3.
 2. To perceive, Rām. 5, 2, 1.
 3. To look up to one, Chr. 3, 7.
 --With उप उप,
 1. To look at, Nal. 22, 5.
 2. To pay regard to, Chr. 55, 5.
 3. To examine, Rām. 4, 29, 29.
 4. To descry, Rām. 5, 29, 4.
 5. To overlook, Pañc. 66, 11; Rām. 2, 23, 16; to disregard, Rājat. 5, 47; to neglect, Rām. 4, 17, 5.
 6. To let escape, Man. 8, 344.
 --With अभ्युप अभि-उप, To forsake, MBh. 16, 160.
 --With समुप सम्-उप, To neglect, MBh. 2, 1960.
 --With निस् निस्,
 1. To behold, MBh. 2, 2463.
 2. To look at, Man. 4, 38.
 3. To look about, Pañc. iv. d. 63, 64 (pass. on account of the metre).
 4. To perceive, Kathās. 2, 19.
 5. To consider, Rām. 5, 84, 5.
 --With संनिस् सम्-निस्, To perceive, Rām. 2, 21, 55.
 --With परि परि,
 1. To look round, Rām. 5, 17, 2.
 2. To examine, Man. 9, 14
 3. To perceive, Rājat. 5, 109.
 अ-परीक्षित, adj. Inconsiderate, Lass. 15, 5; foolish, Lass. 14, 20.
 --See कु-; सु-, adj. Well considered, Pañc. v. d. 16.
 दुष्परीक्ष्य, i. e. दुस्-परीक्ष्य, adj. Difficult to be examined, MBh. 3, 12481.
 --Comp.
 absol. अ-परीक्ष्य, Without due consideration, Pañc. v. d. 16.
 --Caus. परीक्षय, To cause to be examined, Man. 7, 194.
--With प्र प्र,
 1. To look at, Rām. 2, 97, 13.
 2. To suffer patiently, MBh. 3, 526.
 3. To perceive, Pañc. 23, 11.
 प्रेक्षित n. A look, Daśak. [] in Chr. 190, 15.
 प्रेक्षणीय, Worthy to be looked at, Indr. 5, 13.
 --Comp.
 दुष्प्रेक्षणीय and दुष्प्रेक्ष्य, i. e. दुस्-, adj. difficult to be looked at, MBh. 1, 2112; Rām. 3, 30, 35.
 --With अनुप्र अनु-प्र, To see, Draup. 5, 23.
 --With अभिप्र अभि-प्र,
 1. To look at, Draup. 8, 39.
 2. To perceive, MBh. 3, 888.
 --With उत्प्र उद्-प्र,
 1. To look up to, Rām. 5, 85, 5 (उत्प्रेक्ष्यामस्, ii. 2, Par.).
 2. To perceive, Amar. 38.
 --With उपप्र उप-प्र, To overlook, MBh. 1, 3022.
 --With विप्र वि-प्र, To look in different directions, Rām. 3, 52, 3.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र,
 1. To behold, Bhag. 6, 13.
 2. To perceive, Chr. 22, 21.
 3. To consider, Man. 7, 127.
 --With अभिसंप्र अभि-सम्-प्र, To behold, MBh. 1, 3011.
 --With प्रति प्रति,
 1. To wait, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 15; To expect, MBh. 3, 1726.
 2. To endure, Man. 9, 77.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the pres. अ-प्रतीक्षमाण, adj. Not expecting, Daśak. in Chr. 201, 1.
 --With संप्रति सम्-प्रति, To wait, MBh. 1, 2903; Rām. 3, 52, 37; literally: do not dwell here waiting, i. e. do not stay here a moment; to expect, Rām. 1, 73, 13.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To look, Man. 2, 192; pass. to appear, Vikr. d. 132.
 2. To consider, Man. 7, 140.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. वीक्षित, n. A look, Ṛt. 6, 11, v. r.
 --With अनुवि अनु-वि,
 1. To look at, MBh. 4, 1235.
 2. To examine, Rām. 5, 19, 34.
 --With अभिवि अभि-वि,
 1. To look at, Man. 7, 6.
 2. To perceive, Rām. 3, 53, 62.
 3. To consider, MBh. 15, 379 (read -वीक्षते).
 --With उद्वि उद्-वि,
 1. To look up, Amar. 24.
 2. To look to, Śāk. d. 161.
 3. To consider, [] Pañc. i. d. 265.
 --With समुद्वि सम्-उद्-वि,
 1. To look at, Rām. 3, 4, 34.
 2. To perceive, MBh. 3, 12425.
 --With उपवि उप-वि, To look at, Rām. 2, 58, 32.
 --With प्रतिवि प्रति-वि, To perceive, Rām. 1, 15, 26.
 दुष्प्रतिवीक्षणीय and दुष्प्रतिवीक्ष्य, i. e. दुस्-, adj. Difficult to be looked at, MBh. 6, 137; Rām. 2, 23, 3.
 --With संवि सम्-वि, To perceive, Rām. 5, 46, 10.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To look to, Man. 6, 68.
 2. To behold, Rām. 3, 52, 11; to perceive, Hiḍ. 4, 26.
 3. To mind, Rām. 2, 61, 12.
 4. To consider, Man. 7, 26.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the pf. pass. अ-समीक्षित, adj. Unperceived, Rām. 5, 81, 8; of the fut. pass. दुस्-समीक्ष्य, adj. Difficult to be looked at, MBh. 7, 1928.
 --With अभिसम् अभि-सम्, To perceive, Rām. 2, 100, 39.
 --With प्रसम् प्र-सम्,
 1. To see, Man. 7, 214.
 2. To perceive, Rām. 3, 52, 52.
 3. To consider, Man. 5, 49.

ईक्षण ईक्षण, i. e. ईक्ष् + अन, n.
 1. Sight, Kathās. 18, 300.
 2. Care, Man. 7, 141; superintendence, Man. 9, 11.
 3. The eye, Hiḍ. 3, 20.
 --Comp.
ईक्षणिक ईक्षणिक, i. e. ईक्षण + इक, m., f. का, A fortune-teller, Man. 9, 258.
ईक्षितृ ईक्षितृ, i. e. ईक्ष् + तृ, m. An inspector, Man. 8, 91.
इक्षु- + रस इक्षु- + रस, m. the juice of the sugar-cane, Pañc. i. d. 411.
